name: Whitestone
author: Aziel Eliab
one_line: One ephemeral pro se advisor with Criminal, Civil, and Divorce practice areas. Open the live Worker URL on a phone or desktop; optional software zip. Session-only memory; wipe on close. Uploads only, no case exports, no third-party LLM APIs. Hosted app may fetch allowlisted public court/legal-aid pages for the session only.
coverage: High-level procedural overview and checklists for Criminal (bail/arraignment, discovery, plea, sentencing, expungement, rights), Civil (small claims, contracts, landlord-tenant, civil protection orders, name change, debt-collection defense), and Divorce/family (custody, support, dissolution, parentage, guardianship, family protection orders, adoption overview) — all 50 U.S. states and D.C. Not an annotated code.
disclaimer: Educational procedural guidance only. Not a lawyer. Not legal advice. Verify with the court clerk and counsel.
